April 25, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
Guyasuta Investment Advisors Inc decreased its stake in Amerisourcebergen Corp (ABC) by 38.52% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Guyasuta Investment Advisors Inc sold 90,515 shares as the company’s stock declined 9.14% with the market. The institutional investor held 144,438 shares of the other pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $13.26M, down from 234,953 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Guyasuta Investment Advisors Inc who had been investing in Amerisourcebergen Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $19.90B market cap company. The stock increased 0.49% or $0.44 $90.58. About 159,314 shares traded. AmerisourceBergen Corporation (NYSE:ABC) has declined 3.97% downtrending. It has underperformed by 15.52% the S&P500.
Bb&T Corp increased its stake in Pvh Corp (PVH) by 145.5% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bb&T Corp bought 19,411 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.58% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 32,752 shares of the apparel company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.49 million, up from 13,341 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bb&T Corp who had been investing in Pvh Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $12.35B market cap company. The stock increased 0.33% or $0.54 $160.37. About 132,165 shares traded. PVH Corp. (NYSE:PVH) has risen 41.04% uptrending. It has outperformed by 29.49% the S&P500.
Guyasuta Investment Advisors Inc, which manages about $984.22 million and $882.53 million US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 4,096 shares to 21,528 shares, valued at $3.64 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Comcast Corp New (NASDAQ:CMCSA) by 125,985 shares in the quarter, for a total of 254,995 shares, and has risen its stake in Pepsico Inc (NYSE:PEP).
